data.gender_notes: Rohil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rohil is a combination of 'Roha' meaning mountain and 'Il' meaning little. It signifies a courageous and strong individual who is able to overcome obstacles. The name Rohil carries the meaning “Little Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rohil usually hope their child will grow to embody little mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Rohil was a legendary king of the solar dynasty in Hindu mythology, believed to have ruled in the 3rd century BCE. He is known for his valour and justice, and is often depicted riding an elephant in battle.

The Rohil region is mentioned in historical records as early as the 12th century CE, and was a significant centre of power in North India during the medieval period. It was ruled by various Muslim dynasties, including the Mughals, until the 18th century.
